cases.name: Receipts.GeneratedTests.MetadataGenericStructDiagnosticsTests.MetadataGenericStruct_UnkeyedMember_NotReportedInConsumer
cases.message: Expected diagnostics.Where(d => d.Id == "MsgPack004") to be empty because members of types defined in a referenced assembly are validated by that assembly, not the consumer, but found at least one item {error MsgPack004: Properties and fields of MessagePackObject-attributed types require either KeyAttribute or IgnoreMemberAttribute: global::Lib.Item<int>.Unkeyed}.
